name: Daily Standup Prep
description: Prepares structured sprint standup material from your notes and blockers. Reviews sprint progress, flags risks, and generates a standup agenda with retrospective prep for end-of-sprint reviews.

steps.label: Sprint Progress Analysis
steps.description: ANTON analyses sprint plan vs. actual progress and identifies at-risk items.

config.promptTemplate:
Prepare {{standup_type}} material for {{project_name}} — {{sprint_number}}.

Review sprint progress and prepare: what was completed yesterday/this week, what is in progress, what is planned for today/next, blockers and impediments, and sprint burn-down status.

Flag any items at risk of not completing within the sprint and suggest prioritisation decisions.

steps.label: Retrospective Facilitation
steps.description: ANTON prepares retrospective prompts and structures the retro agenda (for sprint reviews only).

steps.label: Team Lead Review
steps.description: Review the prepared material and add team context before the standup.

config.checkpointMessage: Review the standup material and retrospective agenda. Add any team context, mood observations, or specific topics you want to raise.

inputFields.label: Additional team context or topics
inputFields.placeholder: Team morale notes, upcoming leave, external dependencies, stakeholder communications needed...
